name: top_galois_u_eq_sSup
statement: {α β : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] [CompleteLattice β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gc : GaloisConnection l u) (b : β) : u b = sSup {a : α | l a ≤ b}
closed: ∀ {α β : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] [CompleteLattice β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α) (gc : GaloisConnection l u) (b : β), u b = sSup {a : α | l a ≤ b}
informal: The upper adjoint of a Galois connection between complete lattices is given by u b = sSup {a | l a ≤ b} — the set equals Set.Iic (u b) by the adjunction, whose supremum is u b.
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : CompleteLattice α] [inst_1 : CompleteLattice β] (l : α → β) (u : β → α), GaloisConnection l u → ∀ (b : β), u b = sSup {a | l a ≤ b}
